name: send_side_note
description: Send guidance to any running subagent owned by the current process and session. Notes are queued without interrupting the active run, then injected before its next model iteration or prepended to the next follow-up prompt that resumes its session. Notes awaiting a resume survive completion or cancellation until that continuation.

task_id.description: Running subagent task id (from `task` / `task_spawn`), owned by the current process and session. Omit or use an empty string for foreground guidance.

note.description: Guidance content (keep concise, 1-3 sentences, max 8000 chars).
